title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Occupation Re-Certification
content:
**Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit (Closing Cost Credit program) — re-test and re-certification**

Where the program re-tests eligibility on a program or amount change and the loan program changed after verification, the Hometown Heroes credit is re-tested, and the borrower's re-certification of the qualifying occupation re-fixes its award.

For a Hometown Heroes Credit, a change of the base loan amount before closing is handled as follows: while the loan program on the file is unchanged, the award is re-sized by the Hometown Heroes award rule, an increase being booked as a further award entry for the difference and a decrease as a reduction entry for the difference with the reason that the loan amount decreased; where the loan program has changed as well, the award is re-fixed on the borrower's re-certification, which books an increase as a further award entry and books nothing for a re-fixed award that is not above the available balance, so a re-certified Heroes credit is never lowered. Put shortly, a change of the base loan amount alone re-sizes the award under the Hometown Heroes award rule, and a change of the loan program re-fixes it on the borrower's re-certification.

The re-certified Hometown Heroes award is fixed only once the credit's expiration date reaches the signing date scheduled with the settlement agent for the loan. Equivalently, while the credit's expiration date still falls before the signing date scheduled with the settlement agent for the loan, the re-certified award is not fixed.

| Change on the file | Effect on the Hometown Heroes award |
|---|---|
| Loan program changed after verification, with or without a change of the base loan amount | the credit is re-tested; the borrower's re-certification of the qualifying occupation re-fixes the award: an increase is booked as a further award entry, and nothing is booked when the re-fixed award is not above the available balance |
| Base loan amount changed, loan program unchanged | the award is re-sized: an increase as a further award entry, a decrease as a reduction entry with the reason that the loan amount decreased |

### Situation of use and effect of the tool

With `recertify_hero_occupation_0487fd94` the borrower re-certifies, in their own name, the qualifying occupation on a verified Hometown Heroes Credit whose loan file has been re-tested; the re-certification states the base loan amount the award is now fixed on and the amount by which the award rises. Signing records today's date as the credit's verification date and the stated base loan amount as the credit's basis, books one further award entry for the stated increase on the credit's ledger and raises the credit's available balance by the same amount; the credit stays verified. Afterwards the borrower and the desk can see the new verification date and basis on the credit and the further award entry on its ledger.

### How it is invoked

The re-certification is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `recertify_hero_occupation_0487fd94` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, because the re-certification is made in the borrower's own name.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_award_id` | Reference number of the borrower's verified Hometown Heroes Credit being re-certified, as shown by the closing credit lookup for the borrower's loan file. | An identifier, as shown in the lookup. |
| `basis_loan_amount` | Base loan amount the re-certified award is fixed on. | US dollars as a plain number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), no currency sign or thousands separators; stored as given, rounded to 2 decimal places. |
| `award_increase` | Amount by which the award rises on re-certification. | US dollars as a plain positive number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), no currency sign or thousands separators; stored as given, rounded to 2 decimal places. |

### Return

> Occupation re-certified: credit <credit_award_id> re-verified on <YYYY-MM-DD> on basis <basis>; award entry <entry_id> of <amount> booked; available balance <balance>.

<YYYY-MM-DD> is the re-verification date; <basis>, <amount> and <balance> are US dollars with 2 decimals; <entry_id> is the reference number of the further award entry. Receiving this line means the re-certification is recorded and the increase is available; the call has succeeded when the receipt is returned.
